description.zh: 埃及神系与日舟、称心、猫神三则故事收在一套里，共 24 件。
description.en: The Egyptian pantheon plus the solar barque, the weighing of the heart, and Bastet, 24 icons in one kit.

title.en: Horus — falcon of the double crown

description.zh: 立姿荷鲁斯侧身向右：白冠套在红冠里，钩喙突出，青金石身上三排收拢的翼羽，尾羽和两只爪子落在石灰岩台座上。
description.en: Standing Horus faces right: the white crown sits in the red crown, the beak hooks outward, three feather rows mark the folded lapis wing, and the tail and talons meet a limestone plinth.

description.zh: 伊西斯以王座形冠和向两侧展开的三层羽翼占满画幅，骨色侧脸、青金石紧身裙，裙上有一枚小号泰特结。
description.en: Isis fills the frame with a throne-shaped crown and three tiers of wings. A bone profile and lapis sheath dress carry a small tyet.

description.zh: 塞赫美特是侧面母狮首，鬃边围着脸，头顶沙金日盘和一条小圣蛇，左侧留一丛纸莎草。
description.en: Sekhmet is a lioness head in profile, a ruff around the face, a sand-gold sun disk and small uraeus above, with a papyrus clump to the left.

description.zh: 普塔立在凹弧檐的神龛里，戴贴头的青金石小帽和直须，木乃伊形身体前合握一根复合权杖。
description.en: Ptah stands inside a cavetto shrine, wearing a close lapis cap and a straight beard, both hands together on one composite staff.

description.zh: 荷鲁斯之眼横放在小台座上：粗眉用青金石，眼白是骨色，眼线拉长，下面垂着一枚卷纹。
description.en: The Eye of Horus rests on a small stand: a heavy lapis brow, bone white, a long cosmetic line and a curl hanging below.

description.zh: 两根兽首、叉足的瓦斯杖夹着一枚大安卡，安卡下有一小段杰德，最上是缀了三颗星的天空横条，最下是地平线。
description.en: Two animal-headed, forked was sceptres frame a large ankh, a short djed beneath it, a sky bar with three stars above and a ground line below.

description.zh: 侧身而立的黑色胡狼头引路神，金领饰白短裙，手持金杖凝视前方。
description.en: A black jackal-headed guide god in profile with gold collar, white kilt and a gold staff, gazing ahead.

description.zh: 侧身的朱鹭头书记神，长喙微点，旁边是墨盘。
description.en: The ibis-headed scribe god in profile, long beak nodding beside an ink palette.

description.zh: 端坐青金王座的绿脸冥界之王，戴白冠，执弯钩与连枷。
description.en: The green-faced king of the underworld on a lapis throne, white crown, crook and flail.

description.zh: 金色生命之符，背后柔和光晕。
description.en: A gold ankh, the sign of life, with a soft glow behind.

description.zh: 绿色圣甲虫向上推举红色太阳圆盘。
description.en: A green scarab pushing up a red sun disc.

description.zh: 展开的莎草纸卷轴，抽象几何记号，书页翻动，无可读咒文。
description.en: An unrolled papyrus scroll with abstract geometric marks and a turning page, no readable spells.

description.zh: 鹰首太阳神戴青金假发与金领饰，头顶红色圣蛇护着金日轮。
description.en: The falcon-headed sun god with lapis wig and gold collar, a cobra-guarded sun disk above.

description.zh: 端坐的黑猫戴金耳环与青金项坠。
description.en: A seated black cat with a gold earring and a lapis pendant.

description.zh: 金色弯船载着青金船舱与日轮，在尼罗河夜波上航行。
description.en: A curved golden boat carrying a lapis shrine and sun disk over night waves.

description.zh: 带青金双翼的金日轮从地平线升起，放射光芒。
description.en: A winged golden sun disk rising over the horizon with radiating rays.

description.zh: 盘绕的混沌巨蛇，橄榄鳞纹与红眼，风格化而不血腥。
description.en: The coiled serpent of chaos with olive scales and red eye, stylized and bloodless.

description.zh: 展开的纸莎草卷，绘着日轮、山形与装饰纹线。
description.en: An unrolled papyrus with a sun, hill motif and decorative dashed lines.

description.zh: 戴金耳环和宽项圈的圆胖黑猫女神，俏皮地眨眼。
description.en: A round chibi black cat goddess with gold earrings and a broad collar, giving a playful wink.

description.zh: 三只圆滚滚的守护小猫挤在一起跳跃。
description.en: Three plump guardian kittens bouncing together.

description.zh: 顶端有小猫装饰的金色叉铃，铃片叮当摇响。
description.en: A golden sistrum topped with a tiny cat, its jingles rattling.

description.zh: 浮在水面绽放的蓝莲花。
description.en: A blue lotus blooming on the water.

description.zh: 金色头冠上竖起的圆眼小眼镜蛇饰。
description.en: A round-eyed little cobra ornament rearing up on a golden crown band.

description.zh: 长柄棕榈羽扇来回扇动。
description.en: A long-handled palm-frond fan swishing back and forth.
